The PEACE Resilience Model

Framework

Resilience is a protective, mitigating factor with trauma exposure. The PEACE Resilience Model is the first resilience model created for first-responders that integrates into triphasic trauma treatment. It provides practical tools to build resilience and enhance well-being.

  1. P Psychoeducation on Trauma Identify the impact of trauma on the mind and body
  2. E Expand Awareness Enhance emotional and environmental awareness
  3. A Activate Healthy Habits Learn to meet needs across all levels of wellbeing
  4. C Coping with Acute Stress Evidence-based techniques for immediate stress management
  5. E Establish a Plan Individualized plan for building resilience and maintaining wellbeing

Dr. Sarah Stewart-Spencer

IWI Founder
  • Licensed Professional Counselor
  • Licensed Mental Health Counselor
  • Nationally Certified Counselor

Dr. Sarah Stewart-Spencer founded the Integrated Wellness Institute on the conviction that everyone can develop the insight, skills, and strategies needed to live better. She holds certifications as a First Responder Provider, Hypnotherapist and Clinical Trauma Professional.

Former Dean of Behavioural Sciences at Yorkville University, she created the national First Responder Treatment Provider certification program and writes every IWI resilience course alongside the clinicians who developed the framework. Her work is anchored in companion books so the material outlives the login.

The best investment in life is to take time to live it better Dr. Sarah Stewart-Spencer · IWI Founder
